title: Low-degree junta polynomial degree
statement: For each natural number $k$, define the low-degree junta polynomial degree to be $k-c(k)$, where $c(k)$ denotes the low-degree junta cutoff at $k$.
caveat: The definition of the cutoff function is not included in the supplied statement.
